description: Compare wheel width and offset, with an optional spacer, to see backspacing and how far the inner and outer rim edges move, with a to-scale cross-section. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/wheel-offset

newOffset.description: New offset ET (mm) — Signed millimetres; a leading minus is allowed.

newWidth.description: New wheel width (in) — Rim width in inches, 4 to 16.

oldOffset.description: Current offset ET (mm) — Signed millimetres; a leading minus is allowed.

oldWidth.description: Current wheel width (in) — Rim width in inches, 4 to 16.

spacer.description: Hub-centric spacer (mm) — Thickness from 0 to 100. A spacer pushes the wheel outward, lowering the effective offset.
